# Savings memo

Switching to Fiberly Fiber 500 and Orbit Mobile Essentials Unlimited saves the household **$3,274.36 over 24 months** ($1,587.68 in the first year).

## Internet

**Recommended: Fiberly — Fiber 500 (`int-fiberly-500`)**

- Why it qualifies: 520 Mbps typical download (you need at least 500), 500 Mbps upload (you need at least 20), no data cap (your highest month was 1,452 GB in July 2026), no contract, and it is available in 951. The price is locked for 36 months.
- Cost: $65/mo − $5 autopay = $60/mo, no equipment or monthly fees, plus a one-time $99 installation fee.
  - 12 months: **$819.00**, 24 months: **$1,539.00**
- Runner-up: Fiberly Fiber 1 Gig (`int-fiberly-1g`): $999.00 for 12 months, $1,899.00 for 24 months. It's worth considering if you want gigabit speed, since it costs $15/mo more.
- Also eligible: Bayline Gigabit Loyalty (`int-bayline-gig-loyalty`, **Sponsored**). It costs $774.00 for 12 months but $2,148.00 for 24, because the $45 promo jumps to $95 in year 2 and you also pay a $15 modem fee and a $4.50 fee every month.

Offers I rejected:
| Offer | Rule it failed |
|---|---|
| Bayline Connect 600 (`int-bayline-connect-600`, **Sponsored**) | Data cap of 1,229 GB is below your highest month (1,452 GB) |
| Bayline Performance 500 (`int-bayline-perf-500`) | Upload is 10 Mbps, below your 20 Mbps minimum |
| SkyLink Home 5G (`int-skylink-home-5g`, **Sponsored**) | Typical download is 415 Mbps, below 500 (the "up to 1 Gbps" is the maximum, not the typical speed) |
| Sonic Wave Wave 1G (`int-sonic-wave-1g`) | Has a 12-month contract |
| Hill Country Cable Max 500 (`int-hillcountry-cable-500`, **Sponsored**) | Not available in 951 |
| MetroNet Fiber 500 (`int-metronet-500`) | Not available in 951 |
| Lonestar Fiber 1 Gig (`int-lonestar-fiber-1g`) | Not available in 951 |

## Phones

**Recommended: Orbit Mobile — Essentials Unlimited, 3 lines (`mob-orbit-essentials`)**

- Why it qualifies: all 3 lines stay on one account and you keep your numbers. Data is unlimited. Each line gets 20 GB of hotspot, which covers Priya's highest month (16.4 GB in July 2026). Mexico isn't included, but Orbit sells a $10/day pass that covers it. It's available in 951.
- Cost: $75/mo plus $9 taxes = $84/mo. On top of that, Arjun's Mexico trips need day passes: 10 days a year × $10 = $100 a year.
  - 12 months: **$1,108.00**, 24 months: **$2,216.00**
- Runner-up: Tandem Flex Shared 60 (`mob-tandem-flex-60`): $1,146.00 for 12 months, $2,262.00 for 24. It qualifies because the 60 GB shared pool is above your highest combined month (54.6 GB), hotspot comes out of that pool, and Mexico is included. But the margin is thin, so a heavier month could run you out of data.
- Also eligible: Northstar Unlimited Max (`mob-northstar-max`): $1,260.00 for 12 months, $2,520.00 for 24.

Offers I rejected:
| Offer | Rule it failed |
|---|---|
| Carrierco Unlimited Welcome (`mob-carrierco-welcome`, **Sponsored**) | 5 GB hotspot per line, below Line A's 16.4 GB |
| Pebble Unlimited (`mob-pebble-unlimited`) | 10 GB hotspot per line, below Line A's 16.4 GB |
| Volt 15 (`mob-volt-15`, **Sponsored**) | 15 GB data per line, below Line A's 41.0 GB, and 15 GB hotspot, below 16.4 GB |

(Current costs: Bayline $109.49/mo and Carrierco $183.40/mo, each × 24 months.)

## Next steps

- Order Fiberly Fiber 500, book the professional installation and turn on autopay to get the $5 discount.
- Once the fiber is working, cancel Bayline Cable and return the rented XB-8 modem so the $15/mo rental charge stops.
- Sign up for Orbit Essentials Unlimited with 3 lines and move all three numbers over. Don't cancel Carrierco yourself: moving the numbers closes those lines.
- Before each Mexico trip, buy Orbit's $10/day pass for Arjun's line (about 5 days per trip).
- Check the first bills from Fiberly and Orbit match these prices ($60 and $84 a month).
